clue.text: A rep's new role as potential replacement

indicators.note: new suggests the letters are made over into a fresh order

parts.note: a role is an actor's part

explanation.surface: A sales rep's fresh job is seen as a possible stand-in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges A REPS into SPARE; the apostrophe is ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: A spare component is kept ready as a stand-in for one that fails.

clue.text: Total paid initially for oil deposit

parts.note: a total is a sum

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of the word paid

explanation.surface: A total sum paid up front for an oil reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A sump is the reservoir at the bottom of an engine where oil collects.

clue.text: Looking amazed by a good turn around

indicators.note: around tells us to swing the word for turn the other way round

parts.note: your turn in a game is your go

explanation.surface: Someone watching wide-eyed at a kind act.
explanation.definitionFit: Eager, wide-eyed excitement is the sense, a synonym for staring in amazement.

clue.text: English go in to support victory for this horse!

indicators.note: in a down entry, a piece that supports another sits beneath it

parts.note: V for victory, as in the V-sign
to go in is to enter

explanation.surface: Encouragement to back a winning horse at an English race.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'to support' puts ENTER below V.
explanation.definitionFit: An eventer is a horse trained for eventing, the three-part equestrian competition.

clue.text: Two answers about memory evoking smell

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: A is the abbreviation for answer, so two of them make AA
ROM is read-only memory in computing

explanation.surface: Two replies concerning a memory brought back by a scent.
explanation.definitionFit: An aroma is a pleasant smell or fragrance.

clue.text: Forbearance to messy cleaner?

indicators.note: messy signals that the letters of cleaner are jumbled up

explanation.surface: A plea for patience towards a slovenly cleaner.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the joke: a messy cleaner calls for patience, while 'messy' also shuffles the word that follows it.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbearance is patient tolerance of what one dislikes.

clue.text: Fifty per cent of cost doubled with a drink

indicators.note: doubled means the half-word is written twice
fifty per cent is half, so take the first half of the word cost

explanation.surface: A hot drink whose price has been half again doubled.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocoa is a hot chocolate drink made from cacao powder.

clue.text: Creep caught fishing boat losing time

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: losing means a letter is dropped from the boat's name

parts.note: a trawler is a fishing boat that drags a net

explanation.surface: A sneak caught aboard a fishing boat that's running late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Creep' looks like a verb, but it names a fawning person; 'losing' drops the time letter from the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A crawler is a sycophant, someone who grovels to win favour.

clue.text: Bearers of light are able to read freely about party

parts.note: can means are able to

indicators.note: about means the scrambled letters go round the party
freely suggests the letters of read are loosely rearranged

parts.note: LAB is short for the Labour Party

explanation.surface: People who can read loosely around a political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearers of light' sounds like people carrying lamps; 'freely' scrambles read, and 'about' wraps that round the party.
explanation.definitionFit: Candelabra are branched holders that carry several candles.

clue.text: Idiot workers must accept first people who help

indicators.note: to accept is to take in, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: an ass is a fool
worker ants are the classic crossword workers
IST is the abbreviation for first, as in 1st

explanation.surface: Foolish employees must agree to come first in line.
explanation.definitionFit: Assistants are aides, people whose job is to help others.

clue.text: Low points for the elk?

parts.note: to low is to moo like a cow
S and E are two compass points

explanation.surface: A deer's low notes considered on its behalf.
explanation.definitionFit: In America the moose is the animal Europeans call the elk.

clue.text: Source of crude pictures?

parts.note: crude suggests unrefined oil, and pictures made with oil come from artists' tubes of oil-based colour

explanation.surface: Wondering where rough paintings come from.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil-based artists' colours are what oil paintings are made with.

clue.text: Gets very angry about expensive car crushers

indicators.note: about puts the angry word round the car

parts.note: someone who steams is fuming with anger
ROLLER is slang for a Rolls-Royce

explanation.surface: Someone furious about an expensive car being crushed.
explanation.walkthrough: ROLLER is British slang for a Rolls-Royce.
explanation.definitionFit: Steamrollers are heavy machines that flatten road surfaces.

clue.text: Girl holding up train?

parts.note: suggests a robbery on the railway, but the train is a bride's long dress, carried behind her

explanation.surface: A young woman robbing a railway train.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridesmaid attends the bride and may carry the train of her gown.

clue.text: Stick jumper and manuscript in teachers' quarters

parts.note: a staff is a walking stick
a roo, short for kangaroo, is a jumper

explanation.surface: A stick, a sweater and a document found in the school common room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumper' suggests a British sweater, but it is the jumping kangaroo.
explanation.definitionFit: Staffrooms are the rooms in a school reserved for teachers.

clue.text: Counters which are found in chemistry lab?

definitions.meaning: to counter is to answer back sharply

definitions.text: which are found in chemistry lab?
definitions.meaning: glass vessels with long necks used in distilling

explanation.definitionFit: Sharp replies are retorts, and so are long-necked glass distilling flasks.

clue.text: Burns rot on board ship

indicators.note: on board puts a word inside the ship abbreviation

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
to moulder is to rot away slowly

explanation.surface: Fire damage and decay aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that smoulders burns slowly with smoke but no flame.

clue.text: Perfect state of vehicle found in revolutionary Iran

indicators.note: found in puts the vehicle inside the scrambled letters
revolutionary suggests the letters of Iran are overturned into a new order

parts.note: a van is a vehicle

explanation.surface: An ideal vehicle discovered in a post-revolution Iran.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' reads as describing Iran politically, but it signals that the country's letters are rearranged around the vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Nirvana in Buddhism is a state of perfect peace and bliss.

clue.text: Very nearly returned for a coat

annotationWithheld.why: Very nearly returned for a coat (3): the only parse takes 'returned' as CAME BACK, with CAME (nearly) giving CAM and 'back' reversing it, so 'returned' is both fodder and reversal indicator
annotationWithheld.clue: Very nearly returned for a coat

clue.text: Two-faced drunk, dismissing women actually

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters are reeling into a new order
dismissing means a letter is sent away from the fodder

explanation.surface: A hypocrite, drunk and rejecting women, is actually so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissing' removes W from TWOFACED to leave TOFACED, which 'drunk' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: De facto is Latin for in fact, as opposed to by right.

clue.text: Polished and inclined to support Conservative

indicators.note: in a down entry, a supporting piece sits under the other

parts.note: leaned means inclined or tilted

explanation.surface: Smartened up and minded to back the Tories.
explanation.definitionFit: Polishing something is making it clean and shiny.

clue.text: Save to cover river passage

indicators.note: to cover is to go round another piece, enclosing it

parts.note: save in the sense of except, as in all save one

explanation.surface: An instruction to rescue a crossing over a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Save' looks like a verb but means except.
explanation.definitionFit: An excerpt is a short passage taken from a longer text.

clue.text: Revolution covering working with meteorological phenomenon

indicators.note: covering means one piece is wrapped round the other

parts.note: a cycle is one revolution
on means working, as with a switched-on machine

explanation.surface: A spinning storm studied in weather science.
explanation.definitionFit: A cyclone is a large rotating storm system.

clue.text: Watch kept on potential nuclear evils?

indicators.note: potential suggests what these letters could become if rearranged

explanation.surface: Monitoring possible nuclear threats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Surveillance is close observation, keeping a watch on someone.

clue.text: A heartless tyrant in charge of Greece!

indicators.note: heartless removes the middle of tyrant, keeping only its ends

explanation.surface: A cruel despot runs Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Attic means relating to Attica or ancient Athens, hence Greek.

clue.text: Weapons which are put in violin cases?

definitions.text: which are put in violin cases?
definitions.meaning: the rods strung with horsehair that are drawn across violin strings

explanation.definitionFit: An archer's weapons and a violinist's horsehair rods share this same word.

clue.text: Energy required in pitch and run

indicators.note: required in means the energy letter goes inside the pitch

parts.note: pitch is the black tar used for sealing

explanation.surface: A footballer needs energy on the pitch to run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pitch' suggests a sports field, but it is black tar.
explanation.definitionFit: To tear is to rush along at great speed.

clue.text: Decoration for navy chaps after trouble west of Taiwan

indicators.note: after places the navy chaps behind the trouble
in an across entry west of means to the left of

parts.note: ado is fuss or trouble
RN is the Royal Navy
chaps are men
T is Taiwan's international vehicle code

explanation.surface: A medal for sailors after a fracas in the Far East.
explanation.definitionFit: An adornment is an ornament or decoration.

clue.text: Ring area supplying gas

parts.note: O is ring-shaped
a zone is an area

explanation.surface: A ring-shaped region giving off gas.
explanation.definitionFit: Ozone is a form of oxygen, a gas found in the upper atmosphere.

clue.text: Given medicine, does drunk do without love?

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters of does are staggering into a new order
without means a letter is removed from the word do

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so O

explanation.surface: Asking whether a drunk would manage without love once dosed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' makes DOSE from DOES, then 'without' takes O from DO, leaving D.
explanation.definitionFit: To be dosed is to be given a measured amount of a drug.

clue.text: Heir's triumph, with York defenceless

parts.note: success is triumph

indicators.note: defenceless strips the outer letters, the city walls, off York

explanation.surface: A royal heir's victory with York left unguarded.
explanation.definitionFit: An heir is the one who follows on after the present holder.
